core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abaan is an Arabic-origin name meaning “The time (of something)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abaan corresponds to the Arabic form أبان (أ ب ن). Its core sense is first frost; the time of the stars.
